glomeris explain — Why one resource is classified the way it is.

usage: glomeris explain <resource_id_or_path> [--project-root <path>]...
                [--json] [--progress-json]

Read-only — changes nothing.

Shows the full evidence-and-policy picture for a single resource: what was
observed, which rule that triggered, and what would be offered for it. This is
the command to reach for when a classification looks wrong — it shows the
reasoning, not just the verdict. With --json it also emits the
fingerprint_token that `execute` requires for an ASK-classified resource.

Options
  <resource_id_or_path>
      Required. Either a resource id as printed by `detect`, or a
      filesystem path.
  --project-root <path>
      Same meaning as for `detect`. Repeatable.
  --json
      Print an ExplainReport as JSON on stdout, including
      fingerprint_token.
  --progress-json
      Stream progress events as JSON lines to stderr.

Examples
  glomeris explain ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData
      Why is that safe, or not?
  glomeris explain cargo_target_dir:/Users/me/proj/target --json
      Capture fingerprint_token before an ASK execution.

See also: detect, execute
